text:
aisha: Kicking off a gradual promote for v3-int4 with noise-aware thresholds. Rolling 1% -> 5% -> 20% over 6h windows. Wanted to call out the new per-slice variance gate.

 dmitri: Sounds good. Quick q: are we using absolute delta on MRR or z-score across slices?

 aisha: Using z-score normalized per-slice baseline + a robust MAD estimator. Thresholds: |z| > 2.5 triggers autofallback for that slice, global z>1.5 for rollback vote.

 claire: Can we get the exact rule? I need to add to rollout config and the console panel.

 aisha: Rule snippet:
 ```json
 {"slice_metric": "mrr", "estimator": "mad_z", "slice_threshold": 2.5, "global_threshold": 1.5, "min_samples": 200}
 ```

 sam: Also watch latency tail. Int4 is trimming kv precision; p95 +10ms is acceptable, p99 +50ms immediate alert.

 canary-bot: ALERT at 1767777781: slice="long-docs" z=2.8, samples=260 -> autofallback applied, traffic shifted off v3-int4 for slice long-docs :warning:

 aisha: Confirmed, canary-bot action logged. Patch: reduced long-docs to baseline variant.

 dmitri: We saw a 1.2% drop in exact-match for short-answers on the 5% cohort — it's in the signal deck.

 claire: Added a safety net: if any coherent metric delta > 1% AND z>1.8 across top-3 slices, promote halts and notifies SRE + Product.

 sam: Suggest adding a cooldown: auto-promote can resume only after 3 consecutive gates passes over 1h windows.

 aisha: Added cooldown and explicit manual-override flag: "force_promote_reason" logged.

 dmitri: For rollback thresholds, let's keep hysteresis: require metric recovery to be within 0.3σ for 30m before re-enable slice traffic.

 canary-bot: ACTION at 1767777784: global z=1.6 -> rolling back promote from 5% -> 1% pending manual review. Notifying #eng-oncall.

 sam: I'll open a quick playbook thread with steps to repro the long-docs regression and link eval prompts.

 claire: thanks — please include sample prompts and evaluation scripts. We should also snapshot KV cache warmup stats; looks like long-docs had cold-paths.

 aisha: Good catch. We'll add a kv_warmup metric to the gate (min warm hits per sample > 0.5). Putting config PR up now.

 sam: PR: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/12345 — includes gating rules, MAD estimator, and canary-bot ops changes :thumbsup: 

 aisha: good. After PR merges, we'll re-run a 1% staged run with shadow traffic for 3h then re-evaluate.

 dmitri: Also capture cost delta (tokens/sec) — int4 should reduce GPU cycles but warmup regressions could increase tokens/time.

 claire: Agreed. I'll add cost and kv_warmup to the dashboard. Meeting in 30 to finalize thresholds.

 sam: tl;dr: adaptive z-score gating worked — it caught the slice early. Need to tune warmup and hysteresis before full promote.

 aisha: Agreed. End of thread.
